title: Bison (NPS Sound Gallery)
author: National Park Service
changes: Recording of an American bison (Bison bison), commonly called a buffalo, standing in for the African buffalo. Trimmed to 0.30–2.40 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3.
